notes: next_day is the Day number (1-30) to pull from the sheet on the next automation run. Each row is fully pre-researched: a real Semrush-verified main keyword + volume, 2 secondary keywords, a ready meta title/description, the exact URL slug to use as the filename, and a 3-4 sentence content brief describing what the post must cover. The daily agent should use these fields directly rather than re-deriving them, then increment next_day by 1 after a successful publish and commit the change. After day 30, fall back to self-selecting topics from Growpha's service pillars, matching the same voice and doing the same keyword-research rigor, until this file is refreshed with a new calendar.
